translations.web: The children of Israel returned from chasing after the Philistines and they plundered their camp.
translations.bsb: When the Israelites returned from their pursuit of the Philistines, they plundered their camps.
translations.kjv: And the children of Israel returned from chasing after the Philistines, and they spoiled their tents.
